annotations.title: Owner-occupant math for a duplex, triplex or fourplex

description: Runs the site's 2-4 unit owner-occupant calculator: down payment, base loan, FHA upfront and annual MIP, the monthly PITI, the loan against the county limit (when state and county are given), FHA's self-sufficiency test on 3-4 units, the rent a lender can count (75% of the other units), net monthly cost after their rent, and the reserves rule for FHA, VA or conventional.

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as % of price. Defaults to 3.5 (FHA), 0 (VA) or 5 (Conventional).

finance_upfront_mip.description: FHA only: add the 1.75% upfront premium to the loan.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5. Use the rate the buyer was quoted; there is no default.

rents.description: Monthly market rent per unit, one per unit; the first is the unit the buyer will live in. E.g. [1800, 1800, 1800].

state.description: Optional two-letter state code, to check the loan against the county limit.

units.description: Units in the building: 2 duplex, 3 triplex, 4 fourplex.

va_entitlement.description: VA only: full (none in use) or partial (some still in use on another loan).

vacancy_pct.description: Appraiser's vacancy and maintenance estimate, %. The self-sufficiency test uses the greater of this or 25.
